text: Between viewings, the agent opens Closing Copilot on their phone — today's overdue deal is right on top, with every legal deadline on one timeline.
One tap, and Copilot drafts a WhatsApp-ready reminder for the buyer, using the real deadlines from the deal.
Joanne's birthday is next week — Copilot writes the wishes, ready to send.
After a chat, two screenshots become a new customer: facts, family and dated follow-ups, saved only when the agent confirms.
And a booking starts with a photo of the buyer's NRIC. The deal is created in seconds, with the ID masked.
Closing Copilot — works in your pocket. Installable on iPhone and Android.
